name: done
description: Small, finished Claude Code plugins by young1ll — each one does its job and gets out of the way.

plugins.name: parallel-session-workflow
plugins.description: Run several Claude Code sessions on one git repository without them colliding — session-start probe hook, isolated-worktree and shared-checkout modes, claim files with liveness, the FREEZE?/THAW and resource-lock vocabulary, addressing failures, and recovery commands.

plugins.name: session-landing
plugins.description: Get parallel session work onto the remote without races — pre-push probes, one-pusher-per-branch claiming, safe rebase-and-retry instead of force, and landing several sessions' branches in one atomic push.

plugins.name: playwright-shared
plugins.description: One Playwright MCP daemon per machine instead of one per session — each session gets its own tabs, logins flow between sessions automatically, and the browser-profile contention between parallel sessions disappears. Registers the server itself, keeps the daemon up from a hook, installs a login service.
